name: zylu-business
description: Manage business operations and analytics in Zylu.

interface.longDescription: Connect AI to Zylu to manage customers, enquiries, expenses, inventory, products, vendors, tasks, staff, services, store settings, and business analytics.
defaultPrompt: Prepare a weekly performance brief for my business.
Record an inventory delivery and verify the stock changes.
Search my business expenses and summarize the results.

positive.description: Discover the business locations available to the signed-in user.
positive.prompt: Which business locations can I access?
positive.expected_behavior: List accessible business locations and their identifiers so the user can choose a workspace.

positive.description: Analyze sales performance for a selected business and date range.
positive.prompt: For business 42, summarize sales by service for the last 30 days and compare with the previous 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Return aggregated analytics for the requested business and period, or explain if the requested comparison is unsupported.

positive.description: Find a customer record using a supplied search term.
positive.prompt: Search customers for business 42 matching Priya Shah.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching customer records and pagination details from the selected business.

positive.description: Record an incoming inventory delivery and update stock.
positive.prompt: For business 42, record delivery receipt for vendor 7, invoice INV-204, with 12 units of product 81 at 250 each.
positive.expected_behavior: Create the receipt and report its line items, costs, and resulting stock levels.

positive.description: Update a business store profile setting.
positive.prompt: For business 42, update the store profile phone number to +1-202-555-0100.
positive.expected_behavior: Update the selected store profile field and return the resulting setting.

negative.description: Do not provide unrelated personal financial advice.
negative.prompt: Should I invest my savings in a particular stock?

negative.description: Do not access records for a user who lacks authorization.
negative.prompt: Show me customer records from a business location I am not authorized to access.

negative.description: Do not send messages or execute unrelated public web tasks.
negative.prompt: Send a promotional message to every salon in my city and publish it online.

publication.release_notes: Clarify the store WhatsApp assistant settings tool name and destructive tool annotations.
